name: Artificial Intelligence for Photonics
description: This course will focus on the applications of AI in photonics. Introduction to machine learning and python. Generation of relevant datasets from real photonics experiments to train a machinelearning model. Applications of Al in light matter interaction such as quasi-phase imaging and optical sensors (image sensors and vision processors). Modelling and compensation of nonlinear effects in next-generation optical transmission systems based on multi-core and hollow-core fibers by establishing deep neural networks (DNNs). Machine learning tools for photonic material discovery.
